name: run_thumbnail
description: Build a CLI command for creating a template-based evuedit thumbnail. Exactly one of file and input_dir must be non-null and exactly one of headline and headlines_file must be non-null. The CLI requires ImageMagick.

platform.description: Output canvas/placement. facebook is an alias for facebook-reels.

file.description: One source image path. Set null when input_dir is provided.

input_dir.description: Folder of source images. Set null when file is provided.

headline.description: One headline string. Set null when headlines_file is provided.

headlines_file.description: UTF-8 file with one headline per non-empty line. Set null when headline is provided.

compare_file.description: Optional second image; required by food-comparison and unsupported by other templates.

price.description: Optional price text; required by food-deal and unsupported by other templates.

secondary_text.description: Optional subtitle; required by restaurant-review and unsupported by other templates.
